REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for type 2 diabetes, 3 months after metformin dose increase.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports good adherence, no hypoglycemic episodes, home glucose readings averaging 130 mg/dL fasting. No new symptoms.

PHYSICAL EXAM: No lower extremity edema, feet without ulceration or sensory deficit, heart and lungs normal.

ASSESSMENT: Type 2 diabetes, improved control on current regimen.

PLAN: Continue metformin 1000mg twice daily. Recheck A1c in 3 months. Follow up after labs.
